messageTr: 'Invoice' içinde beklenmeyen eleman 'cac:Signature'. Bu konumda beklenen: cbc:TaxCurrencyCode, cbc:PricingCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentAlternativeCurrencyCode, cbc:AccountingCost, cbc:LineCountNumeric.
messageEn: Unexpected element 'cac:Signature' inside 'Invoice'. Expected here: cbc:TaxCurrencyCode, cbc:PricingCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentAlternativeCurrencyCode, cbc:AccountingCost, cbc:LineCountNumeric.
fixTr: Elemanları UBL-TR şemasındaki sıraya göre dizin; 'cac:Signature' yanlış yerde, eksik bir zorunlu elemandan sonra veya yanlış isim alanında olabilir. Beklenen elemanlardan biri (cbc:TaxCurrencyCode, cbc:PricingCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentAlternativeCurrencyCode, cbc:AccountingCost, cbc:LineCountNumeric) eksik olabilir.
fixEn: Put the elements in the order the UBL-TR schema defines; 'cac:Signature' may be misplaced, follow a missing mandatory element, or use the wrong namespace. One of the expected elements (cbc:TaxCurrencyCode, cbc:PricingCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentCurrencyCode, cbc:PaymentAlternativeCurrencyCode, cbc:AccountingCost, cbc:LineCountNumeric) may be missing.
